text_block_list.text: I've come to observe a race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Сэйун Скай is still going, going, annnd
gone! Seiun
Sky goes gate to wire, and it
wasn't even close!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Hehe... Yep, feels good to be first. ♪
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Congrats, Sei! You were unstoppable!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thanks, Spe! Can't believe you
fell for it. ♪
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Fell for what?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hm? Not telling! ♪ It's the secret sauce
to my
strength.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Did you have some kind of strategy
planned
out?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Curious? Should I let you in? Oh,
whatever shall I
do!
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
After all, I might want to use the same
strat to win
again next time we race.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Who knows, maybe my evil plans are
already in
motion! Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Argh, you're a tough cookie to crack!
But I won't
give up!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! ♪ I'm looking forward to next
time!
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: I spot them again on my way home.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, hm, hmmm! ♪ Phew... good thing
my
concert worked out, eh?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up, Spe?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
You seem a little different today, Sei.
Something
about you is... off.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
You're always super clever and hard to
get a
grasp on, like a slippery eel...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
But right now, you seem really genuine
and
honest!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Huh? So, you're saying the normal me is not genuine and honest?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Oh, um! No, that's not what I meant!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know. It's just that... Well, I'm
happy.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
I put in so much hard work to win, so it's
only
natural for me to feel this way.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: I guess honesty is really your policy, Sei!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
You're straight as an arrow, and that's
what I love
about you!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: ...Ack. Now you're the one being way too honest, Spe.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Oh? Are you perhaps... embarrassed?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: ...C-c'mon, we're gonna break curfew.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Let's hurry up!
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
You want me to be honest? Well, I'll
show you
honest.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Right now... I'm super sleepy!
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Sooo, I'm gonna sleep, 'kay? Yaaaawn...
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Waaargh! Wait just a minute, Sei!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Wait up, Sei!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик
